title: Shannon McMinimee Time Audit (Bellevue GC / Wenatchee Matter)

communications.subject: Washington Public Records Act Request: Shannon McMinimee Time Audit (Bellevue GC / Wenatchee Matter)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Public business and personnel records regarding the former Interim General Counsel for the Bellevue School District (BSD), Shannon M. McMinimee (WSBA #34471).

Context for Request:

Publicly available records from administrative proceedings involving the Wenatchee School District indicate a concurrent timeline of outside private practice representation by Ms. McMinimee (operating as McMinimee Law PLLC) during her active employment window with BSD (January 2022 through June 2025). Correspondence and metadata from those proceedings indicate active private case management occurring during standard public administrative business hours.

To evaluate compliance with district policies regarding outside employment, public resource use, and time accounting, I request the following records spanning January 1, 2022, through June 30, 2025:

1. Time and Attendance Logs: Timesheets, payroll hours, calendar entries, or leaves of absence (including vacation, personal, or sick time) submitted by or for Shannon McMinimee on the following specific dates where outside correspondence was recorded:
	• August 16, 2022
	• September 13, 2022 (Specifically tracking hours between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM PT)
	• September 30, 2022 (Specifically tracking hours between 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM PT)
	• October 7, 2022 (Specifically tracking hours between 12:00 PM and 3:00 PM PT)
	• October 11, 2022 (Specifically tracking hours between 8:00 AM and 12:00 PM PT)
	• October 13, 2022 (Specifically tracking hours between 12:00 PM and 3:00 PM PT)
	• February 19, 2025 (Specifically tracking hours between 8:00 AM and 12:00 PM PT)

2. Outside Employment and Conflict Disclosures: Any conflict-of-interest disclosure forms, outside employment authorization requests, dual-employment waivers, or district board approval records filed by or regarding Ms. McMinimee concerning her private firm, McMinimee Law PLLC.

3. District Network/Device Activity Logs: Automated network routing logs or device metadata from district-issued computers assigned to Ms. McMinimee during the specific dates and timeframes listed in Item 1, restricted strictly to identifying whether network connections were routed to external private litigation tools, platforms, or outside administrative bodies.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Kung Fu Joe

communications.communication:

title: (WA ESD 101) All Emails Sent to or Received from mcminimeelaw.com

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

All electronic mail sent to or received from any email address operating under
the domain "mcminimeelaw.com" (matching the wildcard string *@mcminimeelaw.com)
exchanged with any district email account, alias, or internal
routing node, acting as either the author, sender, primary recipient,
carbon copy (CC), or blind carbon copy (BCC) holder.

The chronological scope of this request spans the entirety of the District's
available archival retention window.

TECHNICAL PRE-EXCLUSION OF REPETITIVE SYSTEM DATA:

To maximize administrative processing efficiency, accelerate delivery, and
eliminate unnecessary review burdens, the requester explicitly waives
interest in, pre-excludes, and requests the system-level filtering out of
the following non-substantive records categories:

1. Automated calendar invitations, change notifications, or updates.
2. Automated out-of-office or vacation autoreplies generated by either domain.
3. System-generated IT alerts, ticket confirmations, or password actions.

LIMITATION OF SCOPE & PRE-EXCLUSION OF SENSITIVE DATA:

The requester explicitly pre-excludes and waives any interest in the
Personally Identifiable Information (PII) of any individual student under FERPA.

Pursuant to RCW 42.56.210, if the District asserts that specific internal
staff names or student indicators are exempt from disclosure, the District is
required to apply narrow blackouts exclusively to those individual text strings
while releasing the remaining non-exempt text blocks, financial totals,
and generalized policy or administrative discussions.

Blanket withholding of entire records based on broad assertions of privilege
or exempt status is explicitly contested; only the minimal exempt portions
may be withheld.

MANDATORY STATUTORY COMPLIANCE TIMELINE:

As provided by RCW 42.56.520, a formal response is required within five (5)
business days.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: FOIA US Army record 9/6 Vietnam
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Military service records concerning below:
Name: Joseph Stringham 
Branch: United States Army
DOB: 6/14/1939 
Dates of Service: Approx yrs 1957-Nov1992

Please provide the following documents 
1. copy of Silver Star Medal Award citation 
2. copy of Bronze Star Medal award citations
3. copy of Army commendation award citations
4. copy of Meritorious Service Medal citation 
5. copy of Army Achievement medal citation 
6. Section II Military Education/ training courses form
7. Section V MISCELLANEOUS Form
8. Dates of service, list of awards, date of discharge from active duty 
9. History of Assignments
10. Copy of Legion of Merit medal citations 

Service Unit/Ship: 7th Infantry Division; 17th Infantry Battle Group; Detachment A725, 7th Special Forces Group; Detachment A301, 5th Special Forces Group; 4th Battalion, 31st Infantry Regiment, Americal Division; 75th Ranger Regiment; US Military Group El Salvador; Senior Military Attaché in the US Embassy Mexico; Senior Military Attaché in the US Embassy Brazil; 196th Infantry Brigade
Battles & Campaigns: Vietnam War
Stringham served in the Republic of Vietnam in 1963-64-65 with Special Forces and in 1967-68 with 31st Infantry as a Company Commander and Battalion S-3. In January 1965, CPT Stringham assumed command of a Special Forces A Detachment Camp at Ben Cat, then under heavy pressure from a large Viet Cong unit. From 1975-1979, Major, and then LTC, Stringham commanded three Infantry Battalions, one as a Major, culminating in his assumption of command as the fourth commander of the 1st Ranger Battalion. 

I request hard copies of paperwork in the file showing this information. Please redact per U.S.C. § 552(b)(6).
Please mail hardcopies to following:

DEPT MR#
263 HUNTINGTON AVE
BOSTON, MA 02115

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Eric Bradley
